# User Working Style

## Coding Preferences

Follow existing code style. Prefer editing existing files over creating new ones when possible. Do not add drive-by refactors or unsolicited markdown docs.

## Git Preferences

Only commit when asked. Never update git config. Never force-push main. Use HEREDOC-style commit messages focused on why, not what.

## Frontend Design Rules

Avoid purple-on-white AI-slop themes. Brand must be hero-level on branded pages. Prefer expressive fonts. Full-bleed heroes on landing pages. Default: no cards unless they wrap a real interaction.
